challenge.method: Compared a licensee's counterclaim against an entity alleging contributory patent infringement by an incorporated Contribution with a suit alleging infringement solely by unrelated software. Checked the effective date and read §2 to identify the separate copyright grant.
challenge.results: The counterclaim meets the stated trigger. The filer's covered patent licenses terminate as of the qualifying filing date, without a requirement for a later judgment. The unrelated-software suit lacks the required allegation about this Work. Section 3's termination sentence does not reach the §2 copyright license.

limitations: Whether an actual pleading makes the specified allegation requires its contents. The claim addresses only patent licenses granted under this license for the implicated Work.
reasoning: Section 3 ties termination to the licensee's filing of patent litigation against any entity alleging direct or contributory infringement by the Work or an incorporated Contribution. It expressly includes cross-claims and counterclaims and specifies the patent licenses granted to the filer under this license for that Work. The reopened 1,577-byte revision 1 claim had the requested SHA-256.
